text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I stop by a cafe and spot Fuji Kiseki with a younger Tracen student inside. It looks like they just finished eating.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That limited-time edition caramel and banana cake was so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It really was. But as tasty as it was…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I enjoyed watching you eating happily far more than I did the cake.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Don't tease me like that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm loath to say goodbye, but I unfortunately must go. Let's spend time together again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… Yes, I'm fine. I just have a bit of heartburn.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It happens now and again after I eat sweet things. Haha… Urgh.
